out.in_your_terms: At 1,000 a day, free users get the same allowance they have today and infrastructure cost stays predictable, but sales says it leaves us less competitive. At 5,000 a day, hobbyists and people trying the API get five times the room, which could help adoption and the sales pitch, at about $600 a month more at current signups, and more as signups grow. Finance hasn't weighed in yet. Once a higher free limit is public, lowering it later would upset free users.

send_down.instruction: Set the v2 free tier at 1,000 requests/day, matching v1, and unblock the dependent agent. Route any customer-facing pricing text to Jordan before it ships.
Set the v2 free tier at 5,000 requests/day, and flag the roughly $600/month serving cost increase to finance. Route any customer-facing pricing text to Jordan before it ships.
